power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_starti: I whakaputaina ki tētahi kōhao rino Unbreaking II.
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.name: Kaihanga whakarewa
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.desc: He tohunga mahi toi, he pai ake te kounga o ana taputapu, he pai ake hoki te mahi whakatika.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_repair: He iti ake te utu o te whakatika i te anvil, ā, ka nui ake te roa o te mahi.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_forge_: Ka wahia e ngā ringa tahanga te kohatu, pēnei i te kōhatu kohatu.
Ka tangohia te haurua o te kino mai i te ahi, te awa, te magma, me te wera  kiri whakapakeke.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_starti: I whakatipuhia ki te 4 nga konutea rino hei tīmata i te whakarewa.
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.name: Te tunu kai
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.descriptio: He tohunga tunu kai, he pai ake te kai i hangaia e ia, ā, ka whiwhi ia i te bonus XP i te momi hikareti.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.name: He Kai Pai
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.descrip: E whakarato ana te kai e hanga ana e koe i te hiakai me te makona.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_smoker_xp.na: He Tohunga mo te Momi Hoko
power.neoorigins.class_cook_iron_stomach: E ārai ana i te hiakai me te ngū.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_seasoned_pal: Ka roa ake te 25% o ngā pānga o te rēmana ki a koe.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.name: Ko te Kapi o te Kaihanga
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.descri: I whanau mai me te hoari rino  e hiahia ana nga kaihauturu katoa ki te maripi pai.
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.name: Kaihokohoko
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.descri: He kaihokohoko mohio, e kore e mutu te hokohoko a te tangata o te kainga, e kitea ana e ia he taonga onge mai i nga kaihokohoko haereere.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_trades.d: Kāore rawa ngā tauhokohoko o te kainga e pau i a koe.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_rare_loo: Ka whakawhiwhia e nga kaihokohoko haereere ki a koe nga mahi a nga tangata whenua o te taumata rangatira me te tupono ki te taonga onge.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_starting: I whakatūria ki tētahi emerala hei whakatō i tō tauhokohoko tuatahi.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_silver_t: E 15% ake te roa o ngā pānga o te rēmana ki a koe  ka roa te manaaki.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_lucky_tr: +1 Te waimarie  ka kitea e te waimarie he kaihoko pai.
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.name: He tohunga
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.descript: He kairangahau tapu me ngā āheinga whakarei ake, me te roa o te roa o te rēmana.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_enchanting: Ko ngā tēpu whakamiharo e tuku ana i ngā whakamiharo pai ake i te taha o koe.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_potions.de: He roa ake te roa o ngā pānga o ngā rongoā katoa.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_turn_undea: Ko ngā pānga ki ngā undead ka whakaraerae i a rātau mō te whā hēkona.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_divine_sig: He mārama ake te kite i te marama iti  he koha nō runga.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_starting_b: I whanau mai me tētahi pukapuka tuhituhi mō ngā inoi me ngā tuhipoka.
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.name: He haurangi
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.descript: Kāore i te tino pai ki tētahi mea. I ētahi wā ko te huarahi māmā rawa te huarahi tika.
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.name: Ko Fisher
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.descript: Ko te ora i te taha o te wai  e tiki ana i te waimarie mai i te ngaru, e kaukau ana pēnei i te huka, ā, ka tīmata ki tētahi tokotoko manaakitia.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_waters_luc: Ko te waimarie o te wai
+1 Te waimarie i a koe i roto i te wai  he pai ki a koe te ngaru.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_sea_legs.d: Half drown damage  lungs accustomed to the deep  ngā uaua i whakamahia ki te hohonu.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_starting_r: I whakatipuhia ki tētahi rākau hī ika i whakamanahia ki te Luck of the Sea I me te Lure I.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_night_sigh: Ka whiwhi i te Tirohanga Po i raro i te wai.
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.name: Ko te Mason
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.descripti: E tuku ana te kohatu ki ngā ringa mātanga  ka tere ake te pakaru o ngā kōhatu, ka mau ngā ringa ki te tinana, ā, kei te āhei tonu te hopu.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_hands: Ka wahia e ngā ringa tahanga te kohatu, pēnei i te kōhatu kohatu.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_strong_grip: + 1 kākahu māori mai i te ora katoa o te hopu.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_speed: He 25% tere ake te pakaru o ngā poraka.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_starting_pi: I whakaputaina ki tētahi kōhatu kohatu tōtika I.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_block_reach: +1 te whānuitanga whakatakoto poraka  e mōhio ana te ringa o te taiepa ki te mutunga o te pakitara.
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.name: Ko te Paladin
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.descrip: He toa tapu  e pōhēhē ana te undead i te pa, e kore e taea e te mate te pupuri, a ko te marama o te rama e whakaora ana i nga whara.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_turn_unde: Ko ngā pānga ki ngā undead ka whakaraerae i a rātau mō te whā hēkona.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_holy_armo: +2 kākahu māori  e tiaki ana te marama i a koe.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_beacon_re: Ka āta whakahoutia i te wā e noho ana i roto i ngā poraka e waru.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_starting_: I whanau mai me te hoari rino o te patu I.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_effect_im: Immune to Wither  e kore e taea e te mate te pa ki a koe.
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.name: Necromancer (Tuhinga o mua)
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.descripti: Ko te rangatira o te mate e whakahau ana i ngā kaiwhaiwhai ora-mate  e maroke ana ngā huha me ngā kaikopere e whawhai ana i tō taha, engari e herea ana tōu ake kaha ora ki a rātau.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_with: Whakapā mai i tētahi kōhanga kōhanga kia whawhai mōu. Max 2 i te wā kotahi. E ono ngā utu o te wai. 30 hēkona ki muri. Ka whiwhi koe i te whiu kotahi mēnā ka mate i te whawhai.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_skel: Whakapā mai i tētahi kaipōti kopere ki te whawhai mōu. E toru noa iho i te wā kotahi. E $4 te utu o te waikura. 20 hēkona ki muri. Ka whiwhi koe i te whiu kotahi mēnā ka mate i te whawhai.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_entity_grou: Kua whakarārangitia hei undead. Kua whara i te Hauora Inamata, kua ora i te Pakaru Inamata, e ārai ana i te Wairua. He ngoikore ki a Smite.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_water_breat: Kāore e hiahiatia e ia te manawa. Ka taea te ora i raro i te wai.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_night_visio: Ka āhei te kite mārama i te pōuri katoa. Whakapā atu ki te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.necromancer_daylight_da: Te Whakaheke i te Maama o te Rā
He 1.5 ngā kino ia hēkona i te wā e pā ana ki te rā tika.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_reduced_hea: -3 ngā ngākau (-6 HP mōrahi). He tinana kua pakaru i te makutu o te mate.
Ko te whakahoutanga o te hauora māori ka heke ki te 40% o te tikanga.
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.name: Ko te Gorgon
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.description: He mea whakamataku, he kiri kohatu tōna titiro, ā, ka pakaru ōna ringaringa  engari ka puhoi te taumaha o te kohatu i ia taahiraa.
Ka whakamātao i ngā hoariri katoa e tata ana ki Slowness V. E toru ngā utu o te manawanui. 15 hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.name: Ngā Pīkihi Kohatu
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.desc: E wha ngā whiu atu mō ia whiu.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_granite_hide.des: Permanent Resistance I  ko te kiri kohatu e māmā ana i ngā pānga katoa.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_knockback_resist: E 50 ōrau te kaha o te whakaheke.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.name: He taumaha
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.desc: He 20% te puhoi ake o ngā nekehanga noa.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.name: He nui rawa te rahi
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.description: 15% nui ake i te kaitākaro noa.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_hunger_drain.des: Ka mura ake te 50% o te pūngao  te pupuri i te āhua kohatu.
origins.neoorigins.automaton.name: Ko te mīhini
origins.neoorigins.automaton.description: He hanganga pūkaha e kore rawa e ngū, e mate rānei i te hiakai  engari ka ngaro ngā rongoā whakaora, he huka te whakaora māori, ā, he taumaha ia taahiraa.
power.neoorigins.automaton_iron_frame.de: Resistance Permanent I  he anga rino mārō e kore e whara.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.name: Ko te Chassis kua oti te hiri
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.desc: Kāore e hiahiatia e ia te manawa. Kāore e taea te ngū.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_hunger.des: Kāore rawa ia e hiakai. Ka rere i runga i tētahi pūtake mana ā-roto.
power.neoorigins.automaton_hide_hunger_b: Kei te huna te pae kai  e kore e kai ngā mīhini.
Kei te huna te pae hau  e kore e ora ngā mīhini.
power.neoorigins.automaton_potion_resist: He ārai ki te Whakahou, te Hauora Tere, me te Waikawa. He ōrite tonu ētahi atu pānga o te rēmana.
E āhei ana ngā pūoko whatu i roto i te pōuri ki te kite mārama i te pōuri. Whakapā atu ki te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.automaton_heavy_chassis: He 15% te puhoi ake o te nekehanga  anga taumaha, kaupae taumaha.
E rere ana te whakaora māori i te 25% ōrau  i hangaia hei manawanui, kaua hei whakaora.
power.neoorigins.automaton_knockback_res: 40% te ātete ki te whakaheke i te taumaha noa iho.
origins.neoorigins.kraken.name: Ko te Kraken
origins.neoorigins.kraken.description: He kaiwhaiwhai nui o te moana hohonu i whānau mai i te moana tuwhera  e whakangaro ana i raro i te wai me ngā makawe, me ngā pupuhi waituhi, me te karanga i ngā kaitiaki, engari ka tū ki te takutai, ka tahuna e te rā, ka maroke ki te mata.
power.neoorigins.kraken_tentacle_lash.de: Ka pupuhi i tētahi pōuri e matapo ana, e whakaroa ana hoki i ngā hoariri katoa i roto i te hauwhā o te 6-block. E rua ngā utu o te waikura. E ono ngā hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.name: He whakairo waituhi
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.descrip: E pupuhi ana i tētahi pū o te waituhi pū, e tino whakaroa ana i ngā hoariri i roto i te whānuitanga o te rohe e rima. E rua ngā utu o te waikura. E waru hēkona ki muri.
E ora tonu ana i raro i te wai, ā, e kite mārama ana i roto i te wai, kāore he pōhēhē.
